# tcpshield_networks (Data Source)

Lists every TCPShield network the API key can see.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_networks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) The networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `antivpn_kick_msg` (String) Kick message for a client blocked by `vpn_block`.
- `attack_emails` (Boolean) Whether an email is sent when an attack is detected.
- `client_allow_seconds` (Number) Seconds a client stays allowed after it passed verification.
- `client_ban_seconds` (Number) Seconds a client stays banned once mitigation flags it.
- `connections_per_second_threshold` (Number) Connections per second above which mitigation starts.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `forward_true_slp` (Boolean) Whether server list pings are forwarded to the backend.
- `id` (Number) Numeric network id.
- `mitigation_message` (String) Kick message shown to a client during mitigation.
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `offline_favicon` (String) Base64 favicon shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_kick_message` (String) Kick message shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_motd` (String) MOTD shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_motd_enabled` (Boolean) Whether `offline_motd` answers pings while every backend is down.
- `premium` (Boolean) Whether the network runs on a premium plan.
- `protected_cname` (String) CNAME the network's domains point at to be protected.
- `txt_verification` (String) TXT record value that proves ownership of the network's domains.
- `verification_server` (Boolean) Whether players are routed through the verification server.
- `vpn_block` (Boolean) Whether connections from known VPNs and proxies are blocked.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL notified when an attack starts or ends.
